kind: Read-only existing EventPipe GC correlation; no engine semantic adoption
traceEventBinaryIdentity: Bound by the original profiler10.0.745401 closure; public version-tag review pin is not asserted to match informational build revision.
contracts: Read existing trace first; no workload rerun for event extraction.
GCStart/Stop elapsed can overlap background execution and is not stop-the-world time.
GCSuspendEEStart through RestartEEStop measures a suspension window, including suspension/resumption; classify reason and report unmatched edges.
AllocationTick is Verbose5 while original dotnet-common provider was Informational4; absence is expected, not zero allocations.
AllocationAmount64 is approximate bytes since sampling threshold, not bytes all belonging to TypeName; TypeName names threshold-crossing object.
Use TraceLog timebase to match the same Speedscope conversion; report timebase evidence before overlap claims.
Keep collection, suspension, finalizer and sampled thread-time domains separate; no CPU or causal equivalence.
Analyze under bounded owned job with scoped error mode and caught diagnostic errors; no unhandled negative.NET launches.
